requirement.description: AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' in several test cases involving netlist building and RTLIL conversion. This indicates that the netlist representation is returning tuples instead of dictionaries where dictionaries are expected.
requirement.contract: Fix the build_netlist function to properly handle data structures when converting fragments to netlists. Ensure that when a netlist is built from a fragment, all internal representations maintain the expected data types for downstream processing.

requirement.description: TypeError: Object (switch-value ...) cannot be converted to an Amaranth value. This indicates that SwitchValue objects are not properly handled in the netlist emission process, particularly in assignment contexts.
requirement.contract: Ensure that SwitchValue objects are properly converted to their netlist representations during emission. The conversion should handle the switch-value constructs correctly in assignment contexts.

requirement.description: AssertionError: TypeError not raised in FormatTestCase tests. The error messages don't match the expected format for format validation errors.
requirement.contract: Fix the format validation error messages to match the expected patterns. Ensure that error messages for invalid format constructs match the expected format strings exactly.

requirement.description: AssertionError: "Pattern must be a string or a constant-castable expression, not 1.0" does not match "Case pattern must be a string or a constant-castable expression, not 1.0" - mismatch in error message format for pattern validation.
requirement.contract: Standardize error message formats for pattern validation to match the expected patterns exactly. Ensure consistent error message formatting for pattern validation in Switch/Case constructs.

requirement.description: AssertionError: "Pattern must have the same width as match value" does not match "Match pattern must have the same width as match value" - mismatch in error message format for width validation.
requirement.contract: Standardize error message formats for width validation to match the expected patterns exactly. Ensure consistent error message formatting for width validation in pattern matching.
